tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: In GST assessment from Jul 2017 to Mar 2019, the liability under Reverse Charge Mechanism on license fees to DoT has been recalculated considering the revenue of Group Company. Against this claim the Company has filed reply with GST (Commissioner). The Company has received adjudicating order with aggregate demand of Rs. 204 Lakhs towards GST liability based on reverse charge mechanism for period from 1st July 2017 to 31st March 2019. The Company has filed appeal and then received an Order from Office of the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) on December 22, 2025 confirming the demand raised by Deputy Commissioner of CGST & C.Ex and as a result, the appeal filed by the Company stands dismissed. The update was reported to stock exchange within 24 hours on 22 December 2025.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed Appeal in GSTAT (GST Appellate Tribunal) on 27 June 2026

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: In GST assessment demand cum show cause notice issued for period from April 2019 to March 2022 towards the GST liability under Reverse Charge Mechanism on license fees to DoT has been recalculated considering the revenue of Group Company. The Company has received an Order from Office of the Commissioner of CGST & C.Ex on 10 March 2026 confirming the demand raised by Joint Commissioner of CGST & C.Ex.. The update was reported to stock exchange within 24 hours on 11 March 2026.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed Appeal in to Appellate Authority on 23 May 2026

In GST audit for the period April 2019 to March 2020, the Company received an order raising a demand of ₹11.42 lakhs in respect of certain observations relating to GST Input Tax Credit. Against the said order, the Company filed an appeal before the Commissioner (Appeals), GST and Central Excise. The Company received the appellate order on 22 September 2026, whereby the Commissioner (Appeals), GST and Central Excise dismissed the appeal filed by the Company. The Company is in the process of filing an appeal against the said order before the Hon'ble Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT).
